capabilities: Embed live Sandpack playgrounds in notes
Persist edits to per-block JSON sidecars
Override template, theme and layout per block
extras: Needs internet: Sandpack compiles code via CodeSandbox's hosted bundler (configurable to a self-hosted URL); Python runs locally in a sandboxed worker via Pyodide. Python blocks and mobile are experimental; edits made under 1 s before closing a note can be lost; sidecar cleanup is manual via a command.
problem: Obsidian has no way to run or preview code live inside a note, so trying web frameworks or Python means leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Embed live, editable Sandpack code playgrounds inside your Obsidian notes.
Sandpack sends the code you type in a playground to CodeSandbox's hosted bundler service
Format runs Prettier on the current file.

summary: Live, editable Sandpack code playground embedded in notes, with instant preview for React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript and Python (Pyodide).
